about_the_game:
Step into a shattered realm where legends lie broken and the stars have gone silent. In this immersive RPG adventure—playable in VR or on PC—you are not a destroyer, but a restorer. Wield ancient magic and master the blade as you journey through a universe torn apart by an unknown force.

🌌 Restore, Not Conquer Unlike traditional RPGs, your mission isn’t to slay monsters—it’s to heal them. From majestic dragons to corrupted goddesses, fiery demons to forgotten fae, each creature you encounter is a fragment of a once-harmonious cosmos. Battle them not to kill, but to cleanse their essence and bring balance back to the universe.

🧝‍♀️ Mythic Encounters Explore breathtaking realms filled with lore-rich environments, mysterious ruins, and elemental rifts. Each encounter is a puzzle of combat, empathy, and magic—requiring strategy, timing, and heart.

⚔️ Dual Combat System Choose your path: channel arcane forces with spellcasting or engage in visceral swordplay. Customize your abilities to suit your style, and evolve your powers as you restore more of the world.

🕶️ Built for VR & PC Whether you're fully immersed in VR or playing on desktop, the game offers intuitive controls, cinematic storytelling, and a deeply atmospheric experience.

🌠 A Universe Worth Saving Uncover the truth behind the cataclysm. Who—or what—unmade reality? And why were you chosen to mend it? Your journey will reshape the fate of gods, monsters, and the stars themselves.

short_description: Restore the cosmos. In this immersive RPG adventure for PC and VR, wield magic and steel to heal corrupted goddesses, dragons, demons, and fae. Journey through a shattered universe and uncover the mystery behind its destruction—your destiny is to bring it back to life.
